input.body:
## Step to Reproduce
1. Create a new thought
2. Tap Text Color button
3. Tap in between Font or Background Color buttons


## Current behavior
Text Color Picker is dismissed.
This happens only after first opening the picker. 
If user has selected any color prior, this will not be reproducible. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c7aebe60-86a8-40e7-a4dd-a18d90036a5a

## Expected behavior
The nearest color button should be selected if there is no selection prior or other color has been selected.
The current selection should be removed if user taps in between one of the current selection button. 
Refer to what happens when user has selected any color prior doing step 3
input.title: Tapping in between Font or Background Color buttons dismisses the Color Picker
